integrity: Exact arithmetic in the accompanying self-contained verifier establishes eight exhaustive finite base cases and sharp witness; the written proof supplies the infinite extension and prime-support classification. The formal and independent audits are not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to odd abundant numbers with exactly three distinct prime factors. Does not decide odd weirdness with four or more prime factors, nor guarantee smaller edge subset sums. Possible unindexed equivalent work is a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp central divisor-subset coverage for odd abundant integers with three prime factors
